NEVER use a headless browser or any tool to get past a bot challenge, captcha, paywall, login or other access control (QUALITY criterion 10). A challenge met and then routed around by an ordinary copy (a Wayback capture) must be reported as "challenge met, not passed". A source counts only if you opened it in this session. Prefer primary sources: UNESCO intangible heritage nomination pages and files, museum collection records written by the holding museum, open-access peer-reviewed papers, classical texts in standard editions (Perseus, LacusCurtius), community or tribal statements. A concise Markdown report at your Report path. Source seats use exactly this shape per source: `### NEW-<SeatName>-<n>` then lines `citation:` (author, year, title, venue, stable id), `url:`, `route:`, `kind:` (paper, book, dataset, web, record), `tier:` (A/B/C with a one-line reason), `scope:` (what the row may support), `quotes:` (bulleted, each `<locator>: "<quote>"`), `teaches:` (one line), then `draft sentences:` — 3 to 6 sentences for the entry, each ending with `(NEW-<SeatName>-<n>, <locator>)`, each saying only what a quote or the opened page carries, aimed at what a worldbuilder must decide.
